integrity: All universal spectral statements derive from the full analytic argument. An exact finite verifier supplements the proof but is not an infinite-domain certificate. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous treelike cactus, integer branching at least three, equal-magnitude hoppings and uniform triangular flux. Does not extend to irregular branchings, unequal magnetic fluxes or interactions. Selected gaplessness and zero-cosine-flux specializations covered by earlier work; remaining risk of weakly indexed equivalent free-convolution results.
title: A flux-uniform single-band theorem for high-branching triangular cacti
